CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the volume
   D. The ticket price

2. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   C. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   D. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.
   B. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.
   D. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.

4. Best practice when working on Volleyball: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Volleyball.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Volleyball.
   C. Damage equipment used for Volleyball.
   D. Practise Volleyball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Best practice when working on Weaving: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Weaving.
   B. Practise Weaving with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Weaving.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Weaving.

6. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   B. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   D. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   B. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   D. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Best practice when working on String Musical Instruments and Drawing: (1 mark)
   A. Practise String Musical Instruments and Drawing with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on String Musical Instruments and Drawing.
   C. Damage equipment used for String Musical Instruments and Drawing.
   D. Disrupt classmates during String Musical Instruments and Drawing.

9. Best practice when working on Painting and Collage: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Painting and Collage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Painting and Collage.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Collage.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Collage.

10. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.
   C. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.
   D. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Remove the need for rules

12. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.
   B. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.

13. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Red, blue, and yellow
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Green, orange, and purple

14. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.
   B. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.
   D. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.

15. Best practice when working on Rhythm and Pattern Making: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm and Pattern Making.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm and Pattern Making.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm and Pattern Making.
   D. Practise Rhythm and Pattern Making with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts works 15 Total Number of Lessons 180 NOTE: The suggest and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts works and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain String Musical Instruments and Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
